newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arbor Drugs buy affirmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arbor Drugs buy affirmed.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc said maintained its long-term buy rating for Arbor Drugs Inc and recommended the accumulation of its shares on market-related weakness.
-- Arbor Drugs, which operates a chain of drug stores in Michigan, is expected to have 200 stores in operation by the end of 1997, said Barrington Research.
-- The company has the largest market share in southeastern Michigan, a position Barrington Research doesn't believe is being threatened by the competition.
-- Arbor Drugs stock was down 5/8 at 25-3/4.
